channel.title: Kamlesh Bhagatkar: articles
channel.description: Geopolitics and current affairs from Nagpur, by author and geopolitical analyst Kamlesh Bhagatkar.

item.title: Watching the World from the Centre of India
item.description: Why geopolitics matters to anyone who runs a business, buys petrol or has a child in the army.

item.title: Nineteen Days: What Operation Sindoor Changed for India
item.description: Terror now has an address and a price. Four lessons from the nineteen days between Pahalgam and the ceasefire.

item.title: A Hundred Years of Sewa: What I Learnt Writing About the RSS
item.description: How an organisation with no salaries and no glamour kept going for a century.

item.title: India and the EU Clear the Desk Before Brussels
item.description: The 7th India-EU review in New Delhi shows what is settled before the December trade deal signing, and what still is not.

item.title: Cheaper Cancer Medicines from Today: What Changed and What to Check
item.description: Revised MRPs for 1,364 anti-cancer formulations took effect on 9 November. The government puts consumer savings at Rs 3,540.38 crore a year.
